items.text: Bills ruled out WR DJ Moore due to shoulder injury (landed hard, X-rays, stinger; questionable to return then OUT).
items.why: Shoulder injury + stinger mid-TNF vs Lions.
items.implication: Immediate OUT; monitor severity for Week 3+. Boosts other Bills pass-catchers short-term.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey DNP second straight day (ribs); unlikely available Sunday vs Raiders.
items.why: Rib injury from Week 1; consecutive DNPs.
items.implication: Sit McConkey; Quentin Johnston primary beneficiary for targets/routes.

items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) DNP second straight practice. Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) on IR. If Flowers OUT, Ravens WR hierarchy: Bateman, Devontez Walker, Wester, Sarratt, Moore.
items.why: Aggravated hamstring; consecutive DNPs ahead of Saints.
items.implication: Avoid or bench Flowers; Bateman flex if limited options; Andrews target share already elevated.

items.text: Nico Collins hurt his hamstring in Wednesday practice (history of 5-game miss in 2024); MRI results pending. Week 1 routes: Collins 37/42 Stroud dropbacks, then Hutchinson 29, Boutte 27, Noel 15.
items.why: Hamstring pull in practice; doctors say not serious but status in jeopardy; DNP Thursday; Grade 1 strain.
items.implication: High-end WR2 risk; monitor Friday practice/MRI. If OUT, boosts Texans depth.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson 'ready to go' after missing Week 1 (ankle); full practice. Role vs Stevenson unclear but timing good: Brown on IR, strong upcoming schedule (PIT/JAX/BUF etc before bye).
items.why: Self-declared ready; full practice; Pats need explosives with Brown IR.
items.implication: Flex/handcuff upside; Stevenson still lead but Henderson explosive share possible.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers DNP again (knee surgery last week); has yet to practice since procedure.
items.why: Meniscus trim recovery; no practice yet.
items.implication: High risk for Week 2 vs Chargers; Michael Mayer fringe TE1 if OUT.

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow limited second consecutive day (back injury).
items.implication: Monitor but expected to play per reports; slight downgrade risk vs Houston.

items.text: LOVE Kenneth Walker vs IND: 21/24 RB touches through 3Q (74% snaps), 40% route targets (team lead), 24% overall target share Week 1. Indy just allowed 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry.
items.why: Elite Week 1 usage + soft matchup; RB1 overall range if healthy.

items.text: LOVE Ashton Jeanty @ LAC: Utilization Score 99 Week 1 (tied Bijan league-high). 19% target share last 10; 25+ touches in 3 of last 4.
items.why: Overreaction to injury scare; Kubiak scheme full utilization.
items.implication: Strong RB1/2 start; hold through any residual concerns.

items.text: LOVE Bucky Irving vs CLE: Career-high 26% target share, out-routed Gainwell by 8, all RB red-zone touches. CLE allowed 121 rush yds/4.8 YPC.
items.why: Clear lead over Gainwell in routes/RZ; soft run matchup.

items.text: LOVE DeVonta Smith @ TEN: 27% target share, 13.7 aDOT (3 deep) Week 1. TEN allowed 85% catch rate/16 YPR; 6th-most fantasy PPG to WRs since last year.
items.why: Strong usage rebound spot vs soft secondary.

items.text: LOVE Dak Prescott vs WAS: 21.3 PPG home last year; WAS torched for 14.5 YPC/3 pass TDs Week 1. DAL top-5 implied total (27), game total 50.5.
items.why: Smash home spot vs porous secondary despite quiet Week 1.

items.text: HATE Travis Etienne @ BAL: Matched Kendre Miller rush attempts Week 1; 69% fantasy pts via air. Kamara expected back squeezes role; NO 8.5-pt dogs not run-friendly.
items.implication: Sit/flex only; Miller handcuff upside if Kamara limited.

items.text: Colston Loveland 89% route participation Week 1 (highest TE); only 2 targets/0 pts but missed EZ throw. Dalton Kincaid 69% routes (career high vs last year), 77% snaps; efficient if healthy role sticks. LOVE Kincaid vs DET.
items.why: Elite route rates despite low production; buy low on Loveland, start Kincaid.
items.implication: Loveland hold/buy; Kincaid TE1 upside vs soft DET.
